Leão! You are back. So, how was the week?
Long, but very good. The flight was three hours late, and I had jet lag for two days.
Oh no. And the hotel?
My name wasn't in the system, but they gave me a suite. And on Wednesday I couldn't sleep. A party next door.
Terrible! Did you go to Porto?
Yes, I did. There was a dinner with forty guests. I met Paul again, and I introduced Nina to him.
Nina told me! She liked him a lot. What was your favorite day?
Saturday. I went on a tour, and I sent a postcard to my daughter.
That is lovely. My week was quiet. I was abroad too, in Madrid, but I worked every day.
Every day? That is a sad journey. Was there any time for the city?
Only on Sunday. I saw a museum, and I ate churros. That is my only memory!
Next time, a week like mine. But first I need to unpack.

Hi, Marta! I am back from Lisbon, finally. What a week. The flight was fine, but my bag arrived one day late, so I bought new clothes on the first day. The hotel was small, but the room had a beautiful view of the river. On Tuesday I couldn't find the restaurant you told me about, so I asked a man on the street, and he walked me there! There were only six tables, and the fish was amazing. On Friday I went on a boat tour, and I saw the city from the water. My favorite memory? That kind man on the street. Call me when you can. I need to tell you everything.

My first trip abroad was to Buenos Aires, twenty years ago. I couldn't speak Spanish, and I couldn't speak English. At the airport I needed to find a taxi, but I couldn't read the signs. A woman saw me, and she helped me. In the hotel there was a small problem: my room was not ready, so I waited for three hours. But the city was beautiful. There were old cafes everywhere, and I ate the best steak of my life. I didn't take many photos, but I remember everything. That trip was the start. Since then I want to see the world.

On Monday the flight was late, so I arrived at midnight. On Tuesday my name wasn't in the system, but I got a suite. On Wednesday I couldn't sleep, so I changed rooms. On Friday there were forty guests at the dinner. On Saturday I went on a tour. It was my favorite day.
